# Midwest Industrial Brokers

> Dedicated industrial commercial real estate brokerage platform of Drake Filippis, Associate Broker with Signature Associates. Specializing in manufacturing, cold storage (freezer/cooler & food logistics across Michigan, Ohio & the Midwest), heavy power manufacturing & reindustrialization/reshoring, robotics & automation, data center supply chain manufacturing, sale-leasebacks (with Signature Associates' exclusive national Sale-Leaseback team), defense & aerospace, R&D/lab/cleanroom facilities, Industrial Outdoor Storage (IOS), and brownfield/BEA economic development incentives.

## Core Brokerage Services
- [Disposition](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/disposition/): Selling an industrial building or land? Pricing, marketing and negotiation built to bring the right buyer to the table.
- [Acquisition](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/acquisition/): Buying for your business or your portfolio. A focused search, the right questions and a clean path to closing.
- [Build-to-Suit](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/build-to-suit/): When no existing building fits. Site selection, entitlements and developer coordination for a facility designed around your operation.
- [Tenant Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/tenant-representation/): Leasing warehouse, manufacturing or flex space. Search, tours and lease negotiation on your side of the table.
- [Buyer Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/buyer-representation/): Owner users buying a building for their own business. Search, negotiation and closing coordination with your goals first.
- [Landlord Representation](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/landlord-representation/): Leasing an industrial building or multi tenant flex property. Marketing, tenant outreach and lease negotiation that protect your asset.
- [Investment Sales](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/investment-sales/): Buying or selling leased industrial property. Pricing, marketing and buyer outreach built around income and tenancy.

## High-Intent Industrial Specialties
- [Cold Storage, Freezer/Cooler & Food Logistics](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/cold-storage-food-logistics/): Freezer, cooler, tri-temp (-20°F to 55°F) and USDA/FDA food-grade warehouse brokerage and build-to-suit across Michigan, Ohio and the Midwest cold chain.
- [Heavy Power Manufacturing, Utility Upgrades, Onshoring & Reindustrialization](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/heavy-power-onshoring-manufacturing/): Industrial brokerage for high-amperage manufacturing, onshoring and reindustrialization projects, including direct utility coordination with DTE Energy, Consumers Energy and municipal utilities.
- [Robotics, Automation & Advanced Manufacturing](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/robotics-automation-manufacturing/): Facilities for robotics integrators, industrial automation, autonomous systems and precision manufacturing along the Ann Arbor, Plymouth, Wixom and Oakland County engineering corridors.
- [Data Center Supply Chain & Component Manufacturers](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/data-center-supply-chain-manufacturing/): Manufacturing and assembly facilities for companies producing the critical hardware that goes inside data centers: switchgear, transformers, PDUs, liquid/chiller cooling, server racks and fiber assemblies.
- [Sale-Leaseback & Industrial Capital Advisory](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/sale-leaseback-capital-advisory/): Unlock capital trapped in owned industrial real estate and redeploy it into your operating business, backed by Signature Associates' exclusive national Sale-Leaseback team.
- [Defense, Aerospace & Munitions Supply Chain](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/defense-aerospace-supply-chain/): Secure manufacturing, engineering and assembly facilities for defense primes, tier-1/2 aerospace suppliers and munitions contractors across the Macomb Defense Corridor, Oakland and Washtenaw counties.
- [R&D, Lab Space, Cleanrooms & Battery/EV Testing](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/rd-lab-cleanroom-ev-testing/): High-tech flex, wet/dry laboratories, ISO cleanrooms, pharmaceutical compounding and powertrain/battery testing facilities across Ann Arbor, Plymouth, Livonia, Novi and Auburn Hills.
- [Industrial Outdoor Storage (IOS), Truck Terminals & Fleet Yards](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/industrial-outdoor-storage-ios-truck-terminals/): Zoned industrial outdoor storage (IOS), drop-trailer yards, cross-dock truck terminals and equipment fleet facilities near I-94, I-275, I-75, DTW Airport and Detroit intermodal hubs.
- [Brownfield, BEA & Economic Development Incentives](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/services/brownfield-economic-development-incentives/): Industrial site selection and redevelopment backed by Michigan Baseline Environmental Assessments (BEAs), Brownfield TIF, PA 198 tax abatements and municipal/state economic development incentives.

## County Industrial Hubs (Michigan & Ohio Border Corridors)
- [Wayne County (Wayne County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/wayne-county-mi/): Michigan's largest industrial market: I-275 corridor (Plymouth, Livonia, Canton), DTW Airport/I-94 logistics (Romulus, Taylor, Belleville), Dearborn and Detroit.
- [Oakland County (Oakland County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/oakland-county-mi/): Corporate R&D headquarters, robotics, automation and advanced manufacturing across the I-75 and I-96 Oakland County corridors.
- [Macomb County (Macomb County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/macomb-county-mi/): Heavy power manufacturing, crane-served plants, U.S. defense/aerospace supply chain and I-94 industrial parks.
- [Washtenaw County (Washtenaw County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/washtenaw-county-mi/): Tightest R&D, life-science, flex and precision manufacturing market in Michigan across Ann Arbor, Saline, Ypsilanti and Dexter.
- [Livingston County (Livingston County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/livingston-county-mi/): Fast-growing I-96 and US-23 industrial corridor in Brighton, Howell and Green Oak Township.
- [Genesee County (Genesee County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/genesee-county-mi/): I-75, I-69 and US-23 manufacturing, automotive supply chain and distribution across Flint, Fenton and Grand Blanc.
- [Monroe County (Monroe County, MI & NW Ohio Border Corridor)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/monroe-county-mi/): I-75 and US-23 Michigan-Ohio border logistics, Port of Monroe, and Northwest Ohio cold storage hubs.
- [St. Clair County (St. Clair County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/st-clair-county-mi/): Blue Water Bridge international border hub with 2.5M+ SF of active build-to-suit industrial campus opportunities.
- [Lapeer County (Lapeer County, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/lapeer-county-mi/): I-69 and M-24 manufacturing, plastics, metal fabrication and distribution north of Oakland County.
- [Jackson & Lenawee Counties (Jackson and Lenawee Counties, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/jackson-lenawee-counties-mi/): I-94 West and US-127 precision machining, heavy power manufacturing and regional logistics.
- [Ingham County (Ingham County & Greater Lansing, MI)](https://midwestindustrialbrokers.com/markets/ingham-county-mi/): Central Michigan OEM assembly, EV/battery supply chain and I-96/I-69 distribution hub.

## FAQ
### How does Drake help owners sell or lease an industrial building?
Disposition starts with a walkthrough and a review of the building, the market and your goals. From there Drake builds a pricing and marketing plan, lists the property on CPIX and other industrial channels, reaches out to likely buyers or tenants, and manages tours, offers, negotiation and due diligence through closing or lease signing.

### How does an acquisition search work for owner users and investors?
It begins with a clear list of requirements, such as size, clear height, power, loading, yard, zoning, location and budget. Drake then searches listed and off market options, sets up tours, helps compare buildings side by side, and negotiates the purchase. He also helps coordinate inspections, environmental review, title and financing timing so the deal can close on schedule.

### What is a build-to-suit and when does it make sense?
A build-to-suit is a new facility designed and built around a specific user. It can make sense when no existing building meets your needs, or when your operation needs special features like heavy power, high clear height or extra loading. Drake helps with site selection, entitlements and coordination with developers and contractors, and can compare build-to-suit options with existing buildings.

### How long does it take to lease industrial space?
It depends on the size of the space, how many options fit, the condition of the building and how much work is needed before move in. A simple lease of a ready space can move quickly, while larger spaces or spaces that need improvements often take longer. Starting early gives you more choices and more negotiating room, so it is smart to reach out well before your current lease ends.

### What should I have ready before I start a search?
Helpful details include the size you need, ceiling height, number and type of loading doors, power, parking and yard needs, preferred areas, budget, and your move in date. If you are buying, it also helps to know your financing plan. Drake can help you work through any of these if you are not sure yet.

### Do you represent tenants, buyers, landlords and sellers?
Yes. Drake represents owners on disposition and leasing, and represents buyers and tenants on acquisitions and leases. On every assignment the representation is confirmed in writing at the start so everyone knows who is represented.

### Which areas do you cover?
Drake focuses on industrial property in Plymouth, Livonia, Canton, Ann Arbor, Saline, Novi, Northville, Wixom, the I-275 corridor and greater Metro Detroit. Through Signature Associates he also handles assignments in other parts of Michigan and the region.

### How do I get started?
Call Drake at (248) 941-1125, call the office at (248) 799-3161, or send a short note through the contact form on this site. Share what you need and your timing, and Drake will follow up to talk through next steps.
